metadata.bug: The paused divider can assert a pulse when its held counter is at the terminal count.
metadata.trigger: While running, let the counter reach COUNTER_MAX, then deassert start_stop before the next clock edge and keep it low for at least one edge. Resume afterward; the pulse asserted while paused is ignored, so the resumed terminal count produces no new rising edge.
metadata.effect: The second associated with that terminal count is lost, delaying the stopwatch update until a later pulse.
